patrons.name: A Masked Courtier of the Shadow King
patrons.hookIntro: You face execution for heretical theft, yet a masked courtier offers clemency in exchange for dirty work beneath the earth.

patrons.name: A Scarred Prelate of the Two-Headed Basilisks
patrons.hookIntro: With irons cooling beside the brazier, an inquisitor offers to commute your penance if you cleanse a sunken den of apostates.

patrons.name: A Frost-Bitten Envoy from Alliáns
patrons.hookIntro: Wrapped in grey fur that radiates unnatural chill, Blood-Countess Anthelia's courier demands something vivid brought back from the dark.

patrons.name: A Twitching Bailiff of King Fathmu IX
patrons.hookIntro: Stinking of cheap liquor and paranoia, the bailiff slides a wax-sealed writ across the table—deliver or hang.

patrons.name: A Despairing Undertaker of Grift
patrons.hookIntro: Before the Cliff of Terion claims another hundred souls, this bone-thin clerk wants a stolen heirloom dragged out of the abyss.

patrons.name: A Moss-Caked Witch of Sarkash
patrons.hookIntro: Speaking through a bag of clicking teeth, the witch promises shelter from the spreading forest if you settle an old score underground.

patrons.name: A One-Eyed Fence of the Galgenbeck Gutters
patrons.hookIntro: Your debts have been bought by worse people. Clear this subterranean vault and your ledger is wiped clean.

patrons.name: An Unshaved Monk of the Creton Order
patrons.hookIntro: Trembling over a torn leaf of the Nameless Scriptures, the monk begs you to silence a blasphemous warlock before dawn.

patrons.name: A Frost-Scarred Exile of Bergen Chrypt
patrons.hookIntro: Missing three fingers from the mountain cold, the exile offers silver and salt if you descend into the black cracks below.

patrons.name: A Waterlogged Smuggler from Lake Onda
patrons.hookIntro: Their barge sank under dead-fish mist, and their cargo sits guarded by cannibals in a drowned cellar.

patrons.name: A Graveside Bellman of Graven-Tosk
patrons.hookIntro: The scratching beneath the tombstones stopped only when something dragged the parish relic below.

patrons.name: A Velvety Usurer with Blackened Nails
patrons.hookIntro: Silently counting teeth into a velvet pouch, the usurer gives you three days to recover what was stolen from their strongbox.

objectives.title: Retrieve the Lost Heir
objectives.brief: Find the missing heir locked behind a secret stone chamber and drag him back alive—willing or not.

objectives.title: Claim the Warlock's Head
objectives.brief: Descend to the deepest slaughter-forge, slay the warlock ruling the vault, and return with proof.

objectives.title: Steal the Basilisk Chalice
objectives.brief: Crack the hidden sanctum vault and smuggle out the chalice before the cult completes its rite.

objectives.title: Recover the Blood-Ledger
objectives.brief: Infiltrate the secret archive room and reclaim the ledger naming every heretic in Tveland.

objectives.title: Extract the Missing Confessor
objectives.brief: Locate the surviving priest sealed in the hidden chamber before the dungeon's dwellers devour him.

objectives.title: Taint the Ritual Well
objectives.brief: Reach the hidden vault, desecrate the sanctum altar, and escape before the entire den collapses.

objectives.title: Claim the Crippled Crown Shard
objectives.brief: Unlock the secret chamber behind the idol and take the shard before the rival faction claims it.

objectives.title: Ransom the Kidnapped Baronet
objectives.brief: Bring the noble captive back discreetly; she prefers the dark to her family's court.

objectives.title: Execute the Vault Tyrant
objectives.brief: Cut down the tyrant controlling the apex horror in the pit and escape to claim your bounty.

objectives.title: Retrieve the Icon's Stolen Eyes
objectives.brief: Pry open the secret vault and recover the obsidian eyes stolen from Galgenbeck's altar.

objectives.title: Shatter the Whispering Idol
objectives.brief: Gain entry to the sealed sanctum and smash the idol feeding the dungeon's madness.

objectives.title: Seize Tergol's Flesh-Codex
objectives.brief: Retrieve the forbidden alchemy codex hidden behind the statue's secret door.

centralHazards.name: Rotblack Sludge
centralHazards.description: Sixty feet deep of oily, scorching black gunk reeking of sulfur, bridged only by a pillar where two skeletons play sad violin music.
centralHazards.sensoryHint: Faint, melancholy violin music and hot sulfuric fumes drift from the black cavern.

centralHazards.name: Flooded Blood-Cistern
centralHazards.description: Chest-deep coagulating crimson water choked with floating ribs and iron chains.
centralHazards.sensoryHint: Coppery dampness and heavy splashing echo through the fractured stonework.

centralHazards.name: Bottomless Bone-Chasm
centralHazards.description: A jagged subterranean gorge spanned by rotting rope-planks and slick wet femurs.
centralHazards.sensoryHint: A freezing draft whistles upward from a chasm thick with spider-silk.

centralHazards.name: Boiling Tar-Vats
centralHazards.description: Blistering pools of pitch-black tar bubbling beneath cracked masonry arches.
centralHazards.sensoryHint: Acrid heat and popping tar bubbles blister the nearby walls.

centralHazards.name: Weeping Mercury Pit
centralHazards.description: A mirror-bright lagoon of toxic quicksilver reflecting distorted, screaming silhouettes.
centralHazards.sensoryHint: A metallic taste coats your teeth and silver ripples shiver across the dark.

centralHazards.name: Writhing Root-Maw
centralHazards.description: A tangled sinkhole of pale Sarkash roots dripping sap and human marrow.
centralHazards.sensoryHint: Wet creaking roots shift slowly behind collapsed masonry.

rivalFactions.name: Lesdy & the Three Hosts
rivalFactions.appearance: Long dark hair, dressed in a gunny sack with armholes, seated beside a sweet-smelling campfire inside a glass-walled greenhouse.
rivalFactions.agenda: Wants to turn the apex horror against the dungeon Boss and seize the deep caves.

rivalFactions.name: Sister Vael & the Pale Choir
rivalFactions.appearance: Hollow-eyed acolytes humming in minor key around tallow candles and potted nightshade.
rivalFactions.agenda: Needs outsiders to murder the Boss so they can harvest the sanctum altar.

rivalFactions.name: Marrow-Keepers of the Glass Cellar
rivalFactions.appearance: Mud-caked squatters tending mushrooms grown from prisoner bones behind cracked stained glass.
rivalFactions.agenda: Will drug weary delvers unless bribed or kept strictly on guard.

rivalFactions.name: The Candle-Eaters
rivalFactions.appearance: Feral survivors wrapped in moth-eaten tapestries, sharing melted wax over a brazier.
rivalFactions.agenda: Desperate to see the Boss slain, yet ready to slit throats for food and silver.

rivalFactions.name: The Rat-Penitents
rivalFactions.appearance: Kneeling zealots wearing wire cages full of blind rats around their necks.
rivalFactions.agenda: Wait for a sign from the Seer's prophecy before ambushing unbelievers.

rivalFactions.name: Tergol's Runaways
rivalFactions.appearance: Stitched-up escapees hiding in a warm cellar packed with stolen crates.
rivalFactions.agenda: Offer bandages and stew while sizing up whether the party can be robbed.

rivalFactions.name: The Mirror-Watchers
rivalFactions.appearance: Cloaked heretics staring into cracked silvered glass while singing softly.
rivalFactions.agenda: Trade secrets about the Boss's key for a taste of blood or silver.

rivalFactions.name: The Muffled Bell Coven
rivalFactions.appearance: Hunched bell-ringers with tongues bound in linen, warming skewers over glowing coals.
rivalFactions.agenda: Lure travelers to sit by the fire before springing their knives.

puzzleStatues.name: Black Statue of One-Eyed King Lenard II
puzzleStatues.description: A towering basalt idol with a fresh bloodstained cavity where one eye should be. The cobbled floor tilts slowly toward the abyss.
puzzleStatues.unlockText: You press the eye into the king's bloodied socket. Stone grinds on stone—a heavy secret door cracks open!

puzzleStatues.name: Iron Virgin of St. Anuk
puzzleStatues.description: A rusted statue clutching an empty lead bowl beneath two hollow eye sockets.
puzzleStatues.unlockText: The eye sinks into the hollow socket with a wet click, sliding aside the hidden slab to the sanctum.

puzzleStatues.name: Twin-Headed Basilisk Bust
puzzleStatues.description: Two stone serpents hiss around a sunken keyhole shaped like a human molar.
puzzleStatues.unlockText: The molar locks into the serpent's jaw, retracting the stone bolts of the secret vault.

puzzleStatues.name: Melting Wax Effigy of the Shadow King
puzzleStatues.description: A slumped wax monarch missing its signet ring finger; heat radiates from the wall behind it.
puzzleStatues.unlockText: Slipping the ring onto the wax stub melts the seal with a hiss, revealing the secret vault.

puzzleStatues.name: Blindfolded Cherub of Graven-Tosk
puzzleStatues.description: A weeping stone angel extending an open palm etched with a crescent depression.
puzzleStatues.unlockText: The medallion drops into the cherub's palm. Chains rattle inside the wall as the secret door parts.

puzzleStatues.name: Brass Skull Lectern
puzzleStatues.description: An ancient brass cranium missing its lower jawbone, bolted beside a seamless stone wall.
puzzleStatues.unlockText: The jawbone snaps shut with a metallic shriek, swinging open the secret passage.

tableAEncounters.intro: Dusk gnoums drop chittering from cracks in the ceiling!
Massive oily-furred mongrels lunge out of the dark!
Gaunt guards with filed teeth block your path, licking their lips!
A hound-sized bone-spider drops silently from its ceiling nest!

tableBAnomalies.name: Distraught Spirit
tableBAnomalies.description: A weeping apparition agitated by the depravities of this place begs you to slay the warlock controlling the beast in the depths.

tableBAnomalies.name: Bazaar from a Distorted Dimension
tableBAnomalies.description: Sagsobuth manifests—shapeless, ethereal, her face a vortex of light. She offers Violet Poison (30s) and a Beechwood Tube holding a Foul Protean Scroll (30s).

tableBAnomalies.name: A Terrible Silence
tableBAnomalies.description: All sounds are inexplicably muted in this chamber. Even shouts die on your lips, and scrolls cannot be spoken aloud here.

tableBAnomalies.name: The Shifting Sarcophagus
tableBAnomalies.description: An ornate stone sarcophagus sits dead center in the room, humming faintly beneath a thin coat of dust.
